profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Neiman Marcus
profile.summary:
Developer with background in E-Commerce applications design using ATG e-commerce software, in house development of merchandising software using Flex.

Technology includes Java/J2EE, ATG, JHTML, JSP, FLEX, SQL Server, Oracle.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Designed and Implemented Beauty Replenishment functionality for NeimanMarcus.com.  Lead a group of developers for the project migration of JHTML to JSP for BergdorfGoodman.com and Horchow.com. Worked with team to redesign Checkout process for NeimanMarcus.com that includes back end functional changes to make it more user friendly and faster, UI changes and responsive design.  Developed and maintaining the PayPal functionality for NeimanMarcus.com.

positions.title: E-Commerce Web Developer
positions.description: Leading effort to integrate and maintain site functionality on new platform, including supporting applications and integrations with other systems.  I am the key developer responsible for addressing the many aspects of maintaining an eCommerce site, including troubleshooting the myriad of problems arising from the change of platform to Blue Martini, gathering and interpreting requirements for enhancements, and designing, implementing and integrating solutions for Dickies.com and the Contact Center application.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed and supported e-commerce side of NeimanMarcus.com branded Internet retail sites.  Work individually on enhancements to improve customer experience and data integrity on the websites.  Redesigned the functionality and look and feel of Incircle.com (redemption of benefits earned from NeimanMarcus.com).  Developed and supported merchandising software.

positions.title: Lead Programmer Analyst
positions.description: Lead and Developed customized projects for county clerks and court coordinators to integrate their duties to enhance communication effectiveness and better establish an organized court system.  Developed web application (CMS) on J2EE platform, with architecture based on JSP and JAVA Bean components.

positions.title: Intern Programmer
positions.description: Assisted the lead programmer with researching improved method of validating the X509 signatures for enhancement of trusted bank eTransactions.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
To provide computer science programs of the highest quality through a participatory approach to education, research, and service to the community.; Coordinated and prepared JAVA lab sessions and assignments and applied this to teach the students JAVA applications.
Assisted students with various lab issues, which gave the student confidence to work independently and a positive attitude towards programming.
Relieved the professor of lab responsibilities by assuming the duties of organizing and presenting lab assignments.
Correlated the lab assignments with the professor's classroom lecture so that there was only one set of educational instructions for the students to follow.

positions.title: Intern Programmer
positions.description:
To provide America's soldiers the technology edge through scientific research, technology development, and analysis.
Intern Research and Development Assistant
Worked with Lead research developers to demonstrate that numerical data can be compressed using image formatting and when the data is uncompressed the required accuracy is maintained.
Transferred numerical data into images and worked on these multiple images to investigate existing compression formats using JPEG2000 with an emphasis on Wavelet Model.
Calculated the efficiency and accuracy of data compression on various operating systems; in addition to, determined data throughput and timing requirements.
Used top down design strategy to modify existing code, which simulated real world experience of software development.
